propositions: Plan review currently collapses failed criteria to empty success and checkpoints without recording policy, prompt, contract, or topology inputs, losing operational diagnostics.

The new plan-review strategy adapter must compile Round-A discovery topology into DiscoveryStagePlan units from CriteriaSnapshot and execute through S2 shared kernel while preserving existing YAML/BPMN, facet packing, model ladder, bounded concurrency, cache warming, and cancellation semantics.

Failed, cancelled, skipped, and budget-shed work units cannot serialize as clean checkpoints; successful findings must survive, independent work continue, and dependents skip per the approved failure policy.

The checkpoint key must invalidate (produce zero reuse) when any material, code/ref, policy, prompt, contract, model/mode, topology, context, dependency, or namespace input changes; only content-identical success/resume envelopes seed reuse.

The reducer-ignored review journal stores the safe versioned trace with digest-complete success-only envelopes, while review-plan and review-plan --status outputs retain their narrow end-result contract with no per-unit trace.
Shadow comparison during migration must verify no unapproved selection, order, context, model, budget, usage, cache, checkpoint, or verdict differences exist between legacy and new paths.
